name: GetFileByPath
description: Retrieves a file or folder from SharePoint by its full path using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the file or folder you want to retrieve. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFile.txt

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file retrieval operation, including file details and any error messages.
